entity.name: EHang EH216-S Mecca Hajj Flight
entity.meta_description: The EHang EH216-S pilotless eVTOL completed its debut flight in Saudi Arabia on 12 June 2024 during the Hajj season in Mecca. First autonomous eVTOL passenger trial in the Kingdom.
